recipes.name: Benchlight Solution
recipes.description: Spent rune ash suspended against a live ward shard. The ash remembers a shape for about a day, and this is how you ask it what shape.
recipes.lore_note: Ione has asked twice whether this counts as reading the workshop's notes. Nobody has given her a straight answer.

recipes.name: Annotated Light
recipes.description: A light that picks out handwriting. Ione claims she can read the water damage on a page by it, and has so far been right twice.
recipes.lore_note: It only comes out right at this bench, which nobody has satisfactorily explained and Ione has stopped asking about.

recipes.name: Coldread Solution
recipes.description: Mirror frost carried down two floors before it can think about melting, and put into dust. The light off it is flat and cold and shows a page exactly as it is.
recipes.lore_note: The stairs between the lens and this bench are the reason it works. Ione has pointed out that the wizard put the archive directly under the observatory and that this is unlikely to be a coincidence twice over.

discovery_milestones.title: Exactly Two Flights
discovery_milestones.text: Mirror frost will not survive being carried warm, and it survives exactly the stairs between the lens and the reading room. The archive is the distance below the observatory that the work requires. Nobody wrote that down; the bench proved it.

recipes.name: Lowstar Lantern
recipes.description: Four hours of held starlight, scraped off a ring and given back a little at a time. It is the slowest ingredient in the tower and it makes the longest light.
recipes.lore_note: Whatever the lens was built to do, it has spent twenty unattended years doing this instead, and doing it well enough to be worth collecting.

recipes.name: Ghostline Solution
recipes.description: Ink that left its page, blooming that ate one, and a specimen pressed flat between two others. Together they light the dent a word leaves behind after the word is gone.
recipes.lore_note: Ione asked for this in fewer words than she has ever used. She has eleven months of pages that were removed rather than lost, and scraping does not take the pressure of the nib out of the leaf underneath.

discovery_milestones.title: It Only Shows Pressure
discovery_milestones.text: The solution came out and it does not read ink at all. It finds the dent a nib leaves. Everything scraped off a page in this tower is still in the page, and the method for seeing it took a bloom, a bead of spilled ink and an afternoon.
